title: Design 500k RPS API Gateway & Ingestion (p99 < 50ms)
subtitle: Cell-based blast isolation, offline JWT verify, CoDel load shedding & hedged reads
functionalReqs: Terminate TLS 1.3 and verify tenant JWTs at edge PoPs without synchronous auth-database bottlenecks.
Enforce hierarchical token-bucket quotas (`HTTP 429` + jittered `Retry-After`) during 1.5M RPS flash crowds.
Execute hedged backup RPCs on idempotent reads above `p95` while shipping POST events cleanly via partitioned ingestion logs.

nonFunctionalReqs.rationale: Parallel shard fan-out multiplies p99 slow rates via `1 - (1 - p)^K`.
Bounded Little's Law concurrency (`L = λ * W`) sheds excess load in <0.5ms.
One abusive tenant affects <8% of fleet combinations instead of 100%.

workedSummary.quotaRam: 10M active keys × 64 B = ~640 MB distributed Redis Token Bucket + local 50ms lease cache

explorerTopology.title: 500k RPS Edge Gateway & Adaptive Ingestion Flow
explorerTopology.subtitle: Offline JWKS -> Local Lease Quota -> CoDel Load Shedding -> Hedged Read Mesh
explorerTopology.overview: Tracing 500k RPS from BGP Anycast + Maglev L4 Load Balancers through stateless Rust/Envoy L7 cell gateways into hedged reads and durable async ingestion.
keyTakeaways: Verify EdDSA/RS256 JWT tokens against cached JWKS keys locally so Auth DB outages never stall API traffic.
Amortize Redis quota RTT via 50ms local micro-leases + shed CoDel queue spikes cleanly at ingress.

chaosScenarios.mitigationSummary: Gateway sheds low-priority excess requests in <0.4ms with `429 Retry-After` jitter while keeping critical calls under 38ms p99.

deepDives.title: Little's Law & Adaptive CoDel Load Shedding
deepDives.bottleneck: Unbounded queues blow past 50ms SLA during 1.5M RPS bursts even if CPU isn't 100%.
deepDives.solution: Track queue sojourn latency (`CoDel`) and dynamically cap inflight requests per cell, returning `429/503` immediately with randomized jitter.
deepDives.tradeoff: Rejecting excess non-critical requests cleanly preserves sub-50ms SLA for admitted requests.

deepDives.title: Cell Shuffle-Sharding Blast Containment
deepDives.bottleneck: Global worker pools allow one noisy tenant or buggy retry loop to take down 100% of users.
deepDives.solution: Map tenants deterministically into 2-of-16 orthogonal cells via Maglev + etcd cell directory.
deepDives.tradeoff: Marginally lower bin-packing efficiency in exchange for mathematical tenant isolation.

criteria: Calculates 500k->1.5M RPS bandwidth and explains parallel fan-out p99 amplification
Specifies offline JWKS cache verification and local micro-leased Token Bucket rate limiting
Applies hedged reads (bounded retry budget) and CoDel/Little's Law fast fail-over shedding
Uses shuffle-sharded cells (TPP Orthogonality) and decouples vendor policies behind interfaces
